column1: # Game profile of Mario vs. Donkey Kong (Switch, update 1.0.1 = v65536 over the cartridge base game v0). Plays on the Mac (the opening movie, the title, file select, the first cutscene, level 1-1 with its switches and spring, the pause menu, level select and the save, at 60 fps with sound)

# Nintendo's sead / agl / gsys engine on SDK 15.3.0 with NVN, the SDK's movie library (subsdk0) for its H.264 / AAC cutscenes (Movie/*.mp4 through movie::Extractor), and an AudioOut of its own for their sound.
# The shaders are BNSH / BAHS in RomFS (zstd .zs files) and main, as in the other EPD-style games. Input is the pad only (main imports no touch screen); the provisional profile's guesses held,
# with render_cond added and two host changes in the movie decoder (hle_movie.c: at most 32 audio outputs, one AAC frame per output)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# the base game is a cartridge dump (.xci); only the merged 1.0.1 copy is extracted
# subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library (NintendoSDK_movie 15.3.0), which main imports from
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory: it sets a heap of the application pool − used memory (3.14 GB) and allocates from it.
# The block is 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region
# the NPDM declares no system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# the game skips clears under render conditions (SetRenderEnableConditional): without evaluating them every level was black behind its HUD
